strategy.name: manual_scheduled_all_in_out
strategy.description: 从 2026-01-16 收盘时已经持有的 100 股 QQQ 出发，严格按照用户给出的日期，在每个所列交易日的复权收盘价全仓卖出或把全部现金买回；日期序列本身不由行情生成。
strategy.buy_rule: 在 parameters.trade_schedule 中 side=buy 的日期，以当日常规时段复权 Close 把全部可用现金买入 QQQ，允许小数股。
strategy.sell_rule: 在 parameters.trade_schedule 中 side=sell 的日期，以当日常规时段复权 Close 卖出全部 QQQ；最后一次卖出后保持现金。
strategy.signal_time: 外部给定并视为在各成交日前已知的固定日期日程；不读取当日 Close 生成交易信号。
strategy.execution_time: 清单所列交易日的常规时段复权 Close；PyBroker 在前一交易日提交对应的预定指令。
strategy.position_sizing: 全仓买入或全部卖出；买入允许小数股；不融资、不做空。
strategy.initial_position: 2026-01-16 收盘后已持有 100 股 QQQ，现金为零；引擎种子买入仅用于建立这一既有状态，不计成本。

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: Hold the same initial 100 QQQ shares through 2026-04-13 and mark them to adjusted Close; do not impose an artificial terminal sale.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse the accepted interactive template for zoom, visible-window Y axis, selectable curves, left-edge rebasing and DCA; this experiment adds no new template semantics.

research.hypothesis: The supplied date path can be accounted for exactly and compared with holding the same 100 QQQ shares under explicit transaction-cost assumptions.
research.primary_metric: Total return over the stated interval, with final equity and excess percentage points versus QQQ buy-and-hold.
research.selection_rule: None; there is one frozen date path and no parameter or date selection inside this experiment.
research.validation_plan: Engineering validation only: PyBroker and an independent cash/share ledger must match every daily state, order and closed trade.
research.promotion_criteria: None. A hindsight-selected manual date list cannot be promoted; a causal signal rule must be defined as a separate experiment before walk-forward or paper-trading validation.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject any predictive interpretation, any unavailable scheduled date, any non-alternating position transition, or any ledger difference above tolerance.
